blocks.text: Cloverdale homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Cloverdale, September 2026. Detached houses: 167 listed at month end and 22 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 98 listed at month end and 17 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 100 sold over 4 months against an average of 164.8 listed, about 6.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 29 sold. Condos and townhomes: 69 sold over 4 months against an average of 104.2 listed, about 6.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 19 sold.

faq.q: Is Cloverdale its own city, or part of Surrey?
faq.a: Part of Surrey — Cloverdale is one of the seven communities on the City of Surrey's Our Communities page, described by the City as its historic centre and its third largest community, with Langley to the east and Guildford and Fleetwood to the north.

faq.q: How did Cloverdale sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 201 active listings, 32 solds, a median of $1,212,500 and 19 days on market, while Condos & Townhomes recorded 194 listings, 37 solds, a median of $740,000 and 32 days; inside the community, Clayton moved fastest in both splits (29% detached, 21% attached) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file include Cloverdale Traditional, A J McLellan, George Greenaway, Don Christian, Martha Currie, Sunrise Ridge, Katzie and Hazelgrove elementaries, and Lord Tweedsmuir, Clayton Heights and École Salish secondaries — but catchments are address-based in SD36 and no Cloverdale locator result is on record, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Can a Cloverdale house add a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: One secondary suite per dwelling unit (at most 40% of the principal unit, never inside a coach house or garden suite), a coach house or garden suite of 35–75 m² (up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots below maximum FAR, with lane access required for a coach house on smaller lots), and 3–4 SSMUH units on most lots by size band, up to 6 near a frequent bus stop.

faq.q: What is changing in Cloverdale Town Centre?
faq.a: The City is updating the Cloverdale Town Centre Plan (plan area at Highway 10 and Highway 15, boundary expanded north to 64 Avenue in July 2024) in part to support the planned new hospital and BC Cancer Centre, the City states three SkyTrain stations are planned for Cloverdale under the approved expansion, and TransLink states the Surrey-Langley SkyTrain has an anticipated in-service date of 2029.
